items.headline: Thursday night lights — Seahawks visit the Broncos to open Week 6
items.body: Football's back on a Thursday: Seattle heads to Denver tonight (8:15 p.m. ET on Prime Video) to kick off Week 6. It's a classic NFC-meets-AFC-West primetime scrap with both sides eyeing a playoff push — and a perfect excuse to fire up the wings on a weeknight.
items.say: There's Thursday night football on tonight — Seahawks at the Broncos. Good excuse to order wings midweek. You riding with anybody this NFL season, or just here for the primetime games?

items.headline: Pennant on the line — the ALCS shifts to Cleveland all square
items.body: The American League Championship Series is a dead heat. The scrappy, small-budget Rays and the never-say-die Guardians split the first two games, so now it's effectively a best-of-five with the action moving to Cleveland for Game 3 tonight. Two underdog clubs, one World Series ticket — exactly the kind of October baseball that keeps you up past bedtime.
items.say: The ALCS is all tied up and Game 3's in Cleveland tonight — Rays and Guardians, two little-budget teams slugging it out for a World Series spot. You catching any of the playoffs?

items.headline: A million bucks up for grabs in Malta — CS2's Thunderpick World Championship is live
items.body: Counter-Strike doesn't take a week off. Eight of the world's top squads — defending champs FURIA, plus powerhouses like Falcons and giant-killers Aurora — are battling it out in Malta this week for the $1,000,000 Thunderpick World Championship. The group stage wraps up before the playoffs this weekend and Sunday's grand final. Loud, fast, and a blast even if you've never touched the game.
items.say: There's a million-dollar Counter-Strike tournament going on in Malta right now — all the big teams, final's Sunday. You ever watch any esports, or is it a total mystery to you?

items.headline: The Premier League serves up another big weekend — Arsenal head to Forest
items.body: Club football rolls on with a juicy Matchday 7 slate. The marquee is Nottingham Forest hosting Arsenal on Saturday, with Everton-Chelsea and Manchester City-Ipswich also on the card. Plenty of early-season table-watching as the title picture starts to take shape.
items.say: Premier League's got a big weekend coming up — Arsenal away at Forest is the one I've got my eye on. You follow the Premier League at all, or just the big games?

items.headline: Cinderella's big stage — the WNBA Finals tip off Friday
items.body: The best story in basketball gets its spotlight. The Golden State Valkyries — an expansion team that didn't exist two years ago — open the WNBA Finals on Friday against Angel Reese's Atlanta Dream. Two fresh faces in the title series, zero big-market baggage, and a trophy nobody saw coming back in the spring. Great underdog TV.
items.say: The WNBA Finals start Friday and it's a wild matchup — a two-year-old expansion team against Angel Reese's squad. Love a good underdog story. You catch any of the W this year?

items.headline: Hadouken! The live-action 'Street Fighter' finally lands Friday
items.body: The video-game classic hits the big screen: 'Street Fighter' opens in theaters Friday (Oct. 16), with a gloriously over-the-top cast — Andrew Koji as Ryu, Noah Centineo as Ken, Jason Momoa as Blanka and WWE's Roman Reigns as Akuma. It's a globe-trotting tournament brawler aimed right at the popcorn-and-nostalgia crowd.
items.say: They finally made a new Street Fighter movie — Jason Momoa's in it as the big green guy. Looks like dumb fun. You ever play those games growing up?

items.headline: LISA takes over — 'SaWaDiKa' is smashing records ahead of 'Press Play'
items.body: BLACKPINK's LISA is having a monster solo moment. Her single 'SaWaDiKa' — a Bangkok-set, Muay-Thai-and-tuk-tuks love letter to her Thai roots — blew past 100 million YouTube views in days and became the fastest K-pop video of the year to get there. It's the big teaser for her new EP 'Press Play,' out Oct. 23. Impossible-not-to-move-to pop.
items.say: LISA from BLACKPINK has this song 'SaWaDiKa' that's breaking YouTube records — it's all filmed in Bangkok, super fun. You keep up with any of the new pop, or is that the kids' department now?

items.headline: The gentleman thief returns — 'Lupin' Part 4 lands next week
items.body: One of Netflix's biggest global hits is back: 'Lupin' Part 4 drops all eight episodes Oct. 23. Omar Sy returns as master-of-disguise Assane Diop — this time framed by a copycat pulling museum heists in his name, forcing him to break out and clear it. Stylish, twisty, breezy French crime fun that's well worth the subtitles.
items.say: The new season of Lupin's out next week — the French show about the slick con-man thief. Perfect weekend binge. You ever watch it, or need a new one for the fall?

items.headline: Troye Sivan is back with 'She's the Best' — and Nicole Kidman stars in the video
items.body: Pop favorite Troye Sivan just dropped his fourth album, 'She's the Best,' his first in a few years. The glittery, '80s-New-York title-track video is a whole event — none other than Nicole Kidman turns up in it. Big hooks, big mood, great windows-down driving music.
items.say: Troye Sivan has a new album out and the video's got Nicole Kidman in it, of all people. Really catchy stuff. You keep up with new music, or stick with what you know?
